paragraphs: He is mentioned at the end of Rosh Hashanah according to Dikdukei Soferim, and so the text read before Yuchasin; the text Hyman uses reads Abba son of Rav Binyamin bar Chiyya.[^1][^2]

notes.text: ר״ה here denotes Rosh Hashanah. Its William Davidson digital text at 35a fully writes Abba son of Rav Binyamin bar Chiyya, agreeing with the heading’s full Rav and supporting Rav for the father’s abbreviated title in the body. Hyman’s Ahavah/Abba reading difference remains explicit.

The whole Davidson paragraph at Rosh Hashanah 35a reads Abba son of Rav Binyamin bar Chiyya. This supports the father’s local Rav title; Ahavah remains Hyman’s heading and his Dikdukei Soferim/Yuchasin reports remain attributed, without fresh collation of either work or a father-identity merger.
